svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Frame: 20 x 20 x 2 square tube, 572 wide x 1,063 tall outside, with a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mid rail. Weld square; diagonals equal within 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mesh: the same welded mesh, clamped or welded on the front face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hinges: two weld-on lift-off hinges on the left, 120 mm in from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top and bottom; the fixed leaves weld to the left front strip frame.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Handle: bent 15 x 12 mm bar, 140 mm grip, near the right edge at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tongue: an arm off the right-hand post and a 6 mm plate reaching

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: over the lock rod, with a 14 mm hole centred on the rod.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the gate closes in the opening between 380 and 1,451 mm up;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the lower 320 mm is the fixed lower front panel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Opens outward to the left, about 105 degrees.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: swings without touching the folded rail extension; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tongue hole drops over the rod top without forcing.
